analysis.narrativeEn:
[Trend Position]
· Current price ($73.36) vs SMA5 ($74.95)/SMA20 ($78.60)/SMA50 ($75.72): trading below short-term and mid-term averages, indicating short-term weakness.
· SMA100 ($79.06)/SMA200 ($85.30): long-term trend remains weak.
· 52-week position (13.9%) + current price level near historical lows.
[Momentum Indicators]
· RSI trajectory (55.9 → 40.8): exiting oversold, entering neutral zone, momentum weakening.
· MACD histogram trajectory (-0.4786 → -0.9091): continued worsening, weak signal for trend reversal.
· Bollinger Band current price position (mid-band $78.60): consolidating near the middle band, band width narrowing to 15.70%.
[Support & Resistance Structure]
· Swing support ($70.86): based on 20-day low.
· Swing resistance ($77.30): based on pivot, potential for short-term rebound on breakout.
· 5-day/20-day high/low pattern (forming Higher Low): possibility of recovery signal.
[Volume & Conclusion]
· Volume ratio (0.81x): subdued confidence in price movement.
· Current phase diagnosis (Accumulation phase): consider buying after confirmation of 70.86 support.
